subject: Real-time audit streaming & nightly snapshot delivery — SIG/SOC2 evidence
body:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Real-time audit streaming & nightly snapshot delivery — SIG/SOC2 evidence

Hi Elaine,

Following up on Acme's SIG questionnaire: we can provide a real-time audit feed for admin activity plus a daily immutable snapshot for chain-of-custody. Below is a concise proposal of what we can deliver and configuration options — happy to iterate based on your compliance requirements.

What we can stream (real-time):
- actor_id (user/service)
- action (create/read/update/delete, login, token_issue, token_revoke, model_invoke, provision)
- resource (resource id/type: model, deployment, key, route)
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- request_id, trace_id
- source_ip, user_agent
- role_change (old_role -> new_role)
- admin_console_event (UI action path)
- operator_session_id and session_start/stop (if enabled)
- kv_cache_events (cache_hit/miss/eviction)

Snapshot (nightly):
- Parquet export + CSV header (schema attached)
- Snapshot contains the day’s full append-only ledger for admin events
- Signed manifest (SHA256) and signed URL for download
- Snapshot retention: default 90 days for Hosted; configurable to 1+ years for Dedicated/Private

Delivery options:
- Streaming: Kafka connector (Confluent-compatible) or HTTPS webhook with HMAC signature (rotating keys)
- Bulk: SFTP push, or signed URL to a customer-managed bucket (AWS/GCS)
- On-demand: API to request ad-hoc snapshot (with audit trail)

Security controls:
- All exports encrypted in transit and at rest (customer-managed KMS available for Private deployments)
- Snapshot manifests signed and checksummed; we can include a chain-of-custody audit record when handing off
- Access to export endpoints is permissioned by RBAC; all export actions are themselves logged and available in the stream

Suggested defaults for SIG/SOC2 evidence:
- Min retention for review: 1 year (we can set longer if your policy requires)
- Immutable daily snapshots retained separately for at least 1 year upon request
- Regular cryptographic signing of snapshots and archived manifests

Next steps / ask from Acme:
1) Confirm preferred delivery method (Kafka / webhook / SFTP / signed-bucket)
2) Desired retention (90 days / 1 year / 3 years / custom)
3) Any fields you need added (e.g., PAG/tenant_id, risk_tag)

Attachments: audit_stream_schema.csv (header row + field descriptions), snapshot-instructions.pdf (how to validate manifests and obtain signed URLs).

Thanks — happy to schedule a 30-min sync to walk through options.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Product Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: security.ops@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:37:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Real-time audit streaming & nightly snapshot delivery — SIG/SOC2 evidence

Thanks Alex — this looks promising. A few clarifications from our InfoSec team: 

- For SOC 2 evidence we need a minimum 12 month retention for admin activity logs; for specific artifacts (audit snapshots) we may need immutable copies retained 18 months. Can Redwood support programmatic lock/immute for snapshots?
- Delivery: we prefer either SFTP into an Acme-managed ingestion host or signed-bucket (we control the bucket). Is the signed-bucket option available for Hosted customers?
- Chain-of-custody: can the manifest include a signed timestamp from Redwood and an audit record showing who initiated the export?

Also please confirm whether user impersonation events and service-to-service tokens are included in the stream.

If you can provide answers and a short MSA addendum language we can share with procurement, we’ll loop legal.

Regards,
Elaine Park
Head of Information Security
Acme Health

-----
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:04:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Real-time audit streaming & nightly snapshot delivery — SIG/SOC2 evidence

Hi Elaine — short answers inline: 

- Retention: yes, we support per-account retention policies. Hosted accounts default to 90 days, but we can configure 12–36 months for enterprise Hosted or Dedicated. For Private deployments you can set arbitrary retention consistent with storage capacity and legal policies.

- Snapshot immutability: we produce a signed, time-stamped manifest for each snapshot. For Hosted we can mark snapshots as "retained as evidence" and hold archival copies for the requested period; for stronger legal immutability we recommend Dedicated/Private where snapshots can be WORM-locked in a customer-controlled bucket.

- Delivery to signed-bucket: available for Hosted and Dedicated. For Hosted we will issue a pre-signed write URL with short TTL that you can use to upload; if you prefer Redwood to push, we can push to a bucket you manage (role-based write-only access).

- Chain-of-custody: manifest includes SHA256 checksums, Redwood signing key id, timestamp, and the export action is recorded in the stream with who initiated it (internal user id or API key id). We can include the export action as a separate ledger record.

- User impersonation & S2S tokens: included. We log token issuance, token revocation, and impersonation boundaries (actor:service / acted_for:user) as explicit fields.

Attachments: the attached CSV shows the full export schema and optional fields. Snapshot-instructions.pdf outlines validation steps and how to verify the manifest signature.

Suggested MSA language (draft):
"Redwood will provide administrative activity logs and monthly/daily snapshots as described in Exhibit X. Exported snapshots will be delivered via mutually agreed secure transfer, accompanied by a signed manifest. Redwood will retain copies of evidence for the retention period agreed in the SOW."

If that matches your needs I’ll ask Ops to prepare the sampling/retention configuration and a short appendix for procurement. Would you like a customer-facing One-Pager we can attach to the SOW?

Thanks,
Alex

-----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Real-time audit streaming & nightly snapshot delivery — SIG/SOC2 evidence

Elaine / team — quick internal note from Ops: we can include operator_session_id and kv_cache_evictions (both requested by product security) in the stream and snapshots. We’ll enable stronger signing (RSA-4096 cert) for snapshot manifests for accounts that request legal-grade artifacts.

Marissa — please field the SFTP and signed-bucket connection details once Acme confirms delivery method. Ops will schedule a one-hour handoff to validate ingestion and manifest verification.

Elaine — we’ll draft the appendix language and send a one-pager by EOD Friday.

Jonas Weber
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
